output.advice: 1) Make the subject read as a bird: give the beak a bill shape that widens at the base near star 26366 and tapers to the tip at 27989. Keep the legs clearly bird-like, with a bent joint at 26594 and a splayed foot at 26885, so the figure does not read as a stride. 2) Separate the head stars: move 26207 (crown) higher on the skull and move 26176 (eye) lower and back so they do not overlap. 3) Move labels into clear space: put 'eye' upper-left of the head, put 'base of the beak' below the beak line, put 'wing root' below the wing junction at 25813 so the wingtip star does not cover it, and put 'tip of the beak' above the beak line.
